name: PWM Rectifiers and Inverters
description: Circuit realization of single/three phase voltage/current source inverters from three terminal switching cell, square-wave, quasi square-wave, selective harmonic elimination modulation, total harmonic distortion (THD), sine-PWM, third harmonic injection PWM, discontinuous PWM, space-vector PWM techniques, concept of overmodulation, effect of deadtime, conduction loss and switching loss evaluation, DC-bus capacitor sizing, AC-side filter design. D-Q transformation, phase locked loop, d-q axis current controller design, DC-bus voltage controller design. Single and three-phase active front end rectification. Three-level inverter topologies – NPC, TNPC, etc. Basics of gate-drivers, high side and low side switching, boot-strap gate-drive, isolated gate-driver. Snubber design.
